laneOwner: Claude Code / Opus Max software factory
queueLaw: Packets name the smallest missing capability only. No packet is permission to deploy, spend, contact, or bypass productization gates.

packets.title: Bind AI employee role contracts into relay task identity
packets.economicReason: Repeated research and revenue missions need role-specific evidence, tool, authority, economic, stop, and escalation ceilings without founder re-explaining them or creating new worker systems.
packets.problem: The relay task already binds objective, origin/target, parent, context/evidence, constraints, forbidden actions, outputs, tests, budget, deadline, economic objective, and consequence class. It does not yet canonically bind a versioned employee role contract or prove that execution stayed within its allowed capability set.
packets.missingCapabilityOnly: A versioned employeeRoleRef plus role-contract digest covering allowed capabilities, authority ceiling, evidence prerequisites, economic metric, stop conditions, escalation target, and output schema; bind the digest into task identity and terminal receipt.
hostileInvariants: Unknown or missing role contracts fail closed.
A role cannot expand tools or consequence class supplied by its parent task.
Task replay with a changed role digest is an identity collision.
A model cannot self-promote its authority or declare customer/economic success.
Raw secrets and unnecessary PII remain prohibited.
Existing terminal truth and exact zero-effect requirements remain stronger than the role contract.
testsNeeded: terminal result without role-bound evidence denial
backward-compatibility decision for existing relay fixtures
packets.successCondition: A worker task and terminal receipt are cryptographically bound to one validated employee role without introducing a second relay, scheduler, authority system, or employee registry.
packets.authorityBoundary: LOCAL_PREPARATION_ONLY; no provider or business-world effects.
dependencies: Claude lane claims the packet before editing
Recheck live pull requests for a new concurrent relay-schema implementation

packets.title: Compile the selected evidence sprint into canonical offer and fulfillment contracts
packets.economicReason: If the canary is approved, a reusable versioned scope can reduce founder setup minutes and make payment-to-delivery-to-acceptance lineage auditable.
packets.problem: The research packet defines an exact evidence sprint, but current generic offer templates and catalog entries do not necessarily encode this exact scope, exclusions, founder-minute ceiling, evidence manifest, or partner-brandable acceptance package.
packets.missingCapabilityOnly: One data-driven ServiceSKU/offer template for offer-white-label-lead-path-evidence-sprint-v1, preserving exact scope, exclusions, acceptance criteria, SLA, revision/support ceilings, evidence artifacts, and founder-minute ceiling.
hostileInvariants: No checkout, payment, delivery, or acceptance state may be created from the research artifact.
Only provider-origin cleared payment can start paid fulfillment.
Only external-customer evidence can mark acceptance.
Unverified revenue exposure cannot appear as recovered or lost revenue.
Scope expansion requires a new version and price classification.
No CRM, website, form, call, SMS, email, or production write is implicit in the SKU.
testsNeeded: missing buyer authorization blocks consequential test steps
research artifact cannot advance commercial states
second downstream site requires new fulfillment identity
packets.successCondition: An owner-reviewed local first-payment packet can reference the exact SKU with zero external effects; activation remains separately gated.
packets.authorityBoundary: Build and tests only; no checkout, messages, provider calls, spend, deployment, or customer-system writes.
dependencies: Owner selects the prepared canary for a real commercial probe
Integrator confirms productization gate permits one template before first delivery

packets.title: Add one read-only decision-bound market-signal adapter
packets.economicReason: Automating only decision-changing source checks can reduce repeated research minutes and detect price/policy changes before they create loss.
packets.problem: UberBond has a canonical MarketSignal kernel and bounded registry but no live provider adapter; adding several providers or a broad crawler before a measured need would create cost and duplicate capability.
packets.missingCapabilityOnly: One read-only adapter for the selected provider and one signal class, with source policy, query identity, maximum spend, freshness, idempotency, pagination/webhook reconciliation, and provider receipt.
hostileInvariants: Unconfigured adapter yields zero signals and zero provider calls.
Unknown provider outcome blocks retry until reconciled.
Provider text never auto-promotes to VERIFIED_FACT.
Contradictory observations coexist.
Budget and result limits are enforced before dispatch.
No source adapter creates distribution or contact authority.
packets.successCondition: One current pricing or provider-policy monitor writes canonical read-only signals under a hard cost ceiling and can be paused without losing state.
packets.authorityBoundary: Provider read calls only after explicit credential and budget authority; no contacts, messages, purchases, or production mutations.
dependencies: Owner chooses provider and grants credential/spend boundary
A measured decision need chooses the first signal class

packets.title: Implement deterministic-first read-only browser evidence adapter
packets.economicReason: A reusable evidence runner could reduce delivery minutes for the selected sprint while retaining reproducibility and stopping before side effects.
packets.problem: Current readiness lacks browser proof because Chromium is unavailable, and no buyer-authorized target or scenario exists. A generic autonomous browser would be premature and unsafe.
reuse: existing browser adapter and consequence-boundary modules after exact-main inspection
packets.missingCapabilityOnly: A deterministic-first read-only evidence step contract with allowed origins, session isolation, locator/extraction receipt, artifact hash, timeout, retry, and explicit side-effect classification.
hostileInvariants: CAPTCHA, anti-bot, login, or uncertain control stops execution; no bypass behavior.
Forms, calls, messages, CRM writes, and production mutations are denied by default.
Adaptive model fallback cannot widen the allowed origin, action, or data scope.
Every step records whether an external effect was possible and observed.
Real customer data is prohibited from test fixtures.
packets.successCondition: A local or isolated sandbox run proves the exact read-only contract against a safe fixture and produces a content-addressed evidence receipt.
packets.authorityBoundary: No live buyer site until written scope; no form submissions, logins, messages, purchases, or bypass actions.

noBuildDecisions: Do not create a new CRM, workflow engine, scheduler, payment truth system, opportunity registry, or generic agent swarm.
Do not build marketplace, public MCP, partner portal, recurring monitor, or broad enrichment waterfall before repeated paid demand earns productization.
Do not implement outbound-provider scale while exact small-canary cost, provider policy, DNS, credentials, sender health, and authority remain blocked.
